# Manoj Mathangadeera

> Brand designer, full-stack developer, and digital strategist based in Dubai, UAE. Goes by "Manja". Final-year Computer Science student, building toward AI research.

Manoj works across three disciplines, chosen per project rather than by default: brand identity design, full-stack web development, and digital strategy. 15+ websites delivered, 50+ brand projects, 20+ years combined across design and development.

## About

Nature taught him to see structure and shape first. Code just gave him a faster way to build with it. Started in design, not code. Years of building brand identities and visual systems for clients before moving into full-stack development. Now builds the sites and systems that carry those identities too, from the ground up. Freelancing gives him the freedom to keep choosing different problems instead of settling into one: brand strategy, full-stack builds, digital campaigns, plus consulting on AI-era digital presence for brands still running on old playbooks. That same pull toward new problems is why he's finishing a BSc in Computer Science, with AI research next.

## Services

- **Brand identity**: logos, guidelines, visual systems.
- **Web development**: full-stack builds, from landing pages to complete business sites.
- **Digital strategy**: social, content, and campaign work.
